Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule
Are you passionate about turning data into insights that drive real business decisions ?
We’re looking for a Power BI Business Performance Analyst within our DR i V team who can connect data, technology and commercial performance . You’ll partner with Sales and business leaders across EMEA, uncover trends and opportunities, explain what’s driving performance, and bring the story behind the numbers to life through powerful Power BI dashboards.
If you enjoy challenging the data, finding the “why” behind performance, and turning complex information into clear actions , this could be the role for you.
 What You Will Do
 Business Analysis & Performance Reporting
Analyze EMEA business performance, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
Support Sales and other business teams with regular performance reporting, business reviews, and ad-hoc analysis.
Investigate variances against budget, forecast, and historical performance, providing insights into underlying business drivers.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business stakeholders.
Support management in monitoring key business KPIs and understanding performance across customers, products, markets, and regions.
 Power BI & Reporting Development
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models aligned with business needs.
Translate business requirements into effective and user-friendly reporting and analytical solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability through appropriate validation, testing, and documentation.
Drive automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of reporting processes.
Apply best practices in data visualization, report performance, and Power BI development.
 Business Collaboration
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
Communicate analytical findings and business insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support business teams in effectively using reporting solutions and developing a data-driven approach to decision-making.
 What Will Make You Successful
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data or related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
Business analysis & problem solving
Proven ability to deliver and optimize reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Business performance analysis, KPI and management reporting
Commercial understanding
Transform business requirements into effective reporting solutions
Any reporting automation and process improvement experience is considered a plus
Project management and working with cross-functional business teams experiences are considered an advantage
Strong proficiency in Power BI, incl. DAX, SQL, Power Query, Semantic models
Good SQL knowledge
Advanced Excel skills
Understanding data visualization principles and reporting best practices
Experience with Fabric, Python or R or Power Automate is a plus. 
 What Do We Offer
Hybrid work schedule
13th salary (paid in 3 installments)
Additional 5 paid leave days per year (calculated proportionally to the period worked)
Monthly budget to spend on Flexible Benefits Platform
Well-being bonus (1-time bonus after probation period)
A medical subscription (Medicover)
Access to the Bookster platform
Access to the Employee Assistance Program
